offering_description.value: Provides air and ocean freight forwarding, customs brokerage and supply chain logistics services to businesses worldwide. It arranges and manages cargo movement using purchased carrier capacity, its own warehouses and technology systems.

primary_services.value: air freight forwarding; ocean freight forwarding; customs brokerage; warehousing and distribution; supply chain and order management

customer_segment.value: B2B: importers, exporters, retailers, manufacturers, technology and healthcare companies shipping cargo

end_markets.value: retail; technology and electronics; healthcare; industrial manufacturing; aerospace; automotive

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight forwarding charges, customs brokerage fees and warehousing and distribution services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys air, ocean and ground carrier capacity and resells integrated forwarding and customs services to shippers; asset operator: operates warehouses and distribution facilities used for customer inventory

geography_served.value: global: Offices across the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Africa and India

specialization.value: related lines: air and ocean freight, customs brokerage, warehousing and other logistics services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales staff selling to shippers, global network of company-owned offices; online: proprietary web-based shipment visibility and booking platform

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: customs brokerage licensing (US CBP), FMC ocean freight forwarder licensing, TSA and IATA air cargo security rules
